PLAN "Return to Snow: 12-Week Meniscus Rehab Strength Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Rebuild lower-body strength and stability for return to skiing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 — Foundation and Tissue Tolerance" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower Body Foundation A":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          hip_abduction 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          quad_stretch 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m

      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Body A":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 90s
          lat_stretch 90s
          shoulder_stretch 90s

      DAY Friday training 50m "Lower Body Foundation B":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x30s rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 2m
          figure_four_stretch 2m
          calf_stretch 90s

    WEEK 2:
